## Summary

Describe the user-visible change and the component that owns it.

## Scope

- What changed:
- What intentionally did not change:

## Verification

- [ ] Relevant unit tests added or reviewed
- [ ] `python -m unittest discover -s tests -q` (with a display for GUI tests)
- [ ] Ruff / Mypy / Pyright checks pass, or deviations explained
- [ ] Native Windows behavior checked if taskbar, focus, overlays, dragging, timing or hardware access changed
- [ ] Version-one save compatibility preserved or migration documented
- [ ] No personal `.env`, save files, secrets, logs, fonts or generated packages committed
- [ ] Asset changes include provenance/licensing notes and accurate captures, if applicable

## Notes for reviewers

Mention compatibility paths, manual test conditions and any follow-up work.
